- Usage trends and top queries (Monica)
- Cost/throughput implications for scale
- Next-quarter forecast & amendment options
- Action items & timing for procurement

Hi Aditya —

I am so sorry — we had an urgent exec meeting come up and I missed our slot this morning. My apologies to you and Monica.

Can we please rebook? Next week is better for us. I can do Wed or Thu between 10–3 PT. Procurement may want to join if we talk amendments.

If you can share a 15–20 minute slot first so we can run through the raw numbers, that would help before bringing procurement on for pricing.

Thanks for understanding — I know these run tight with renewals.

— Susan

Director, Platform Ops | Greenline Health
susan.peters@greenline.com

Subject: Re: QBR: Usage review + next-quarter capacity planning (May 18)

Thanks Susan — no problem at all.

Available slots (all PT):
- Wed May 26, 10:30–11:00 (15–30m quick recap)
- Wed May 26, 13:00–13:45 (full QBR)
- Thu May 27, 11:00–11:30 (15–30m)
- Thu May 27, 14:00–14:45 (full QBR)

If procurement wants to join, they can pick one of the full QBR slots and we’ll include a brief pricing appendix and the amendment path. Monica will walk usage and the suggested capacity uplift required to hit your target latency/throughput.

In the meantime, attaching a one-page forecast artifact describing three amendment tiers so procurement has a sense of sizing/pricing before the call.

Proposed next steps:
1) Pick a slot (or propose alternatives)
2) Aditya/Monica run a 15–20m usage review if helpful
3) Procurement joins a full QBR to agree amendment language & timeline

Open to doing the short usage touch first if that makes scheduling easier.

Cheers,
Aditya

[Attachment: greenline_qbr_deck_May2027.pdf (pdf)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Peters <susan.peters@greenline.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 17:20:05 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR: Usage review + next-quarter capacity planning (May 18)

Hi Susan —

I can run the usage portion. A short prep call (15 minutes) would let me validate spike windows and pre-compute the KV cache impact so the QBR itself can focus on business decisions.

Suggested prep slots (PT): Wed May 26 10:30 or Thu May 27 11:00. I’ll bring a short list of observed top endpoints and two small charts: 1) peak 5-day rolling token throughput, 2) tail latency at 95/99.

If procurement will only be doing paperwork, the prep can remain just ops folks. If they plan to discuss upgrade tiers, we should include them on the full QBR.

Thanks — I’ll stand by for the slot you pick.

— Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Susan Peters <susan.peters@greenline.com>

Subject: Re: QBR: Usage review + next-quarter capacity planning (May 18)

Thanks both — Wed May 26 at 10:30 PT for the 15-minute usage prep works for us. Procurement will review the forecast afterwards and I’ll route the DocuSign amendment to you once they greenlight numbers.

Two quick asks before the prep call:
- Can you share the 7-day peak/day and a very rough monthly spend projection for the expanded tier?
- Please flag any breaking changes or model swaps we should be aware of in the next 30 days.

If you can drop those in the Drive link ahead of the call, great — otherwise a quick screen share works.

Appreciate your flexibility — looking forward to the prep on Wed.

Best,
Susan
